stem: A dehumidifier alarm repeats nightly as crop biomass increases, while the same system handled early vegetative stages easily. What is a plausible system-level explanation?
choices: Changing crop transpiration/moisture load may be consuming available capacity margin
The sensor labels are causing humidity
The cultivar name changed the thermostat firmware
Early-stage capacity proves late-stage capacity must be adequate
rationale: Moisture load rises with crop size and transpiration, so capacity margin can disappear later in the cycle.
